SpartanPort: unofficial PC port of God of War III Remastered (PS4) for Windows and Linux (AppImage). Original x86-64 code runs directly on the CPU with a custom runtime; graphics use shadPS4's Vulkan video core. Launcher, in-game menu, controller icons and up to 240 FPS. Requires your own game dump. No game files included.
